briefDescription: Daily Life Lessons is an interactive knowledge-sharing platform designed to help users document, reflect on, and share valuable life lessons, productivity tips, and personal growth insights with a global community.
challenges: Implementing Stripe payment gateway for secure online payments.
Managing complex client-side state during real-time post interactions and bookmarking.
Make authentication secure and implement role based authentication
futureImprovements: Add AI-powered personal lesson recommendation engine.
Integrate audio lesson recording and playback capability.
Implement local payment gateway like bkash, Nagad etc.

briefDescription: Reports Zone is a web application where users can reports any local problems, issues likes load-shedding, network-overload, and many more. It is an automated analytical and reporting dashboard that allows businesses to aggregate operational metrics and generate visual charts.
challenges: Processing large datasets efficiently on the backend without causing UI freeze during chart rendering.
Ensuring user can add report perfectly without any errors.
Implement secure authentication by using betterauth
futureImprovements: Implement strict role based access control system
Make sure user can contact developer team for any issues.
Add custom drag-and-drop image for report

briefDescription: Doc Appoint is a modern healthcare portal connecting patients with specialized doctors. Users can search specialists, book real-time appointment of the doctors. They can edit and delete their appointment
challenges: Make sure that user can edit or delete their appointment.
Make sure Users can get doctors by searching their name
Make sure that, once user booked an appointment, modal will close automatically
futureImprovements: Preventing Double appointment for a doctor at once
Add automated SMS and WhatsApp appointment reminders via Twilio.
Implement digital prescription generation and medical history storage system.
